sample_unit: adults with valid simultaneous smartwatch and PSG recordings

links.outcome: Smartwatch algorithm performance in a Korean cohort versus South-American training cohorts (inter-ethnic validation)
links.effect: eAHI correlated strongly with aiAHI (rho 0.88, ICC 0.87); sensitivity 92.3%, specificity 92.6% for moderate-to-severe OSA; systematic underestimation, especially in mild OSA.
links.quote: The model was trained in South‑American cohorts, allowing inter‑ethnic validation.

screen.reason: Prospective clinical validation of an AI-based smartwatch algorithm for estimating AHI against simultaneous polysomnography in patients, evaluating diagnostic accuracy rather than a deployment safeguard.
